deadline.intake: August 2027 intake, Round 2 (Round 1: 23 Nov 2026; Round 3: 14 Apr 2027; Round 4: 23 May 2027); international applicants are encouraged to apply in Rounds 1 and 2

tuition.note: Year 1 tuition for August 2027 intake (AY 2027-28), international students; residence INR 228,000 extra; scholarships available

requirement.text: SAT/ACT scores are not mandatory (recommended); the Ashoka Online Assessment is mandatory for all applicants, followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates. Applicants need a government-approved ID and a computer with a webcam. Admission is merit-based; merit and need-based scholarships are available.
